title: Discipline Working-Paper Archives, Preprint Servers & Legal Repositories
description: Domain-specific scholarly repositories providing rapid access to working papers, mathematical/computational proofs, and primary jurisprudence—accompanied by strict peer-review hygiene rules.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.governance_and_funding: Operated by Cornell Tech (Cornell University) with support from the Simons Foundation and member research libraries.
concept_use_cases: Explaining frontier AI/ML architectures, cryptographic attacks, quantum error correction, superconductivity claims, and computational methods
Tracing whether an arXiv preprint was subsequently accepted at a peer-reviewed conference (NeurIPS, ICML, IEEE S&P, Physical Review Letters)
known_limitations_and_biases: Moderated for scope and plausibility, NOT peer-reviewed prior to posting—viral preprints (e.g., room-temperature superconductor claims or sensational AI benchmarks) can fail independent replication within weeks
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: ALWAYS label arXiv manuscripts explicitly as 'non-peer-reviewed preprint' unless a linked journal/conference DOI confirms peer-reviewed publication; check Semantic Scholar for replication attempts.

sources.name: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)
sources.governance_and_funding: Private, non-partisan 501(c)(3) research organization; only elected Research Associates and Faculty Research Fellows may circulate NBER Working Papers, and NBER bans policy recommendations inside working papers.
concept_use_cases: Empirical identification strategies (difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, RDD) estimating causal impacts of tariffs, minimum wages, sanctions, interest rates, and industrial subsidies
Official U.S. Business Cycle Dating Committee recession chronology definitions
known_limitations_and_biases: NBER Working Papers are pre-publication drafts distributed for scholarly critique prior to formal journal peer review
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Label as 'NBER Working Paper (pre-journal peer review)', check whether a revised peer-reviewed journal version exists (parameters often change during refereeing!), and pair with RePEc/CEPR for European and global macro perspectives.

sources.name: RePEc / IDEAS
sources.governance_and_funding: Decentralized volunteer-driven open bibliographic archive hosted on IDEAS by the Research Division of the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
concept_use_cases: Accessing working papers from 100+ central banks (ECB, Bundesbank, Bank of England, Reserve Bank of India, Banco de México), CEPR, IMF, and global university departments
known_limitations_and_biases: Combines peer-reviewed journal articles with unrefereed departmental working papers—distinguish venue type explicitly
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Verify whether the RePEc record is a Working Paper Series entry or final Journal Article, and inspect econometric identification assumptions.

sources.name: SSRN (Social Science Research Network)
sources.governance_and_funding: Owned and operated by Elsevier since 2016.
concept_use_cases: Retrieving full-text law review drafts, corporate-governance analyses, regulatory comment scholarship, and financial-market microstructure studies
known_limitations_and_biases: Low barrier to posting unrefereed manuscripts—advocacy white papers and unvetted empirical claims sit alongside drafts by leading scholars; US law reviews are largely student-edited rather than blind peer-reviewed
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Verify author institutional credentials, check if subsequently published in a peer-reviewed journal, and never cite an unrefereed SSRN upload as settled empirical consensus.

sources.name: bioRxiv & medRxiv
sources.governance_and_funding: Operated by openRxiv / Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (with Yale and BMJ co-founding medRxiv).
concept_use_cases: Early genomic characterization or transmission parameter estimation during fast-moving infectious disease outbreaks, strictly paired with peer-reviewed baselines
known_limitations_and_biases: HIGH EPISTEMIC RISK IN PUBLIC HEALTH: Unrefereed clinical preprints have repeatedly driven global misinformation when cherry-picked by media before statistical errors or fraud were caught
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: MANDATORY GUARDRAIL: Never use a medRxiv/bioRxiv preprint to guide clinical decisions or state settled medical fact; explicitly state 'unrefereed preprint', check whether a peer-reviewed journal version superseded it, and pair with Cochrane/PubMed/WHO context.

sources.name: PhilPapers
disciplines: Just War Theory & Ethics of Armed Conflict
sources.governance_and_funding: Maintained by the Center for Digital Philosophy at Western University (Canada), supported by academic library subscriptions and grants.
concept_use_cases: Clarifying normative, legal-philosophical, and epistemological concepts underlying current debates (e.g., proportionality vs. distinction in Just War Theory, algorithmic fairness impossibility theorems, free-speech doctrine)
known_limitations_and_biases: Analytic Anglophone philosophy predominance relative to continental and non-Western philosophical traditions
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Present competing normative frameworks fairly (steel-manning major positions) rather than treating contested ethical philosophy as an empirical fact.

sources.name: WorldLII & Free Access to Law Movement Institutes
sources.governance_and_funding: Collaborative non-profit Legal Information Institutes (AustLII, BAILII, CanLII, Cornell LII, SAFLII, AsianLII, AfricanLII).
concept_use_cases: Verifying exact statutory text, constitutional articles, bilateral investment treaties, and appellate court precedents across 120+ jurisdictions
known_limitations_and_biases: Consolidated statutory updates can lag official parliamentary gazettes by weeks in some jurisdictions—verify recent amendments
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Check statute effective dates, jurisdictional applicability, and whether an appellate decision was subsequently overruled or stayed.
